raw_segments.text: Here, be it known that though these wild fishermen do not, as a general thing, and according
to the great military maxim, make the enemy defray the current expenses of the war, at
least before realizing the proceeds of the voyage.
Yet now and then, you find some of these Nantucketers who have a genuine relish for that particular
part of the sperm whale designated by stub, comprising the tapering extremity of the body.
